result.summary: Enables the clang-tidy check `readability-redundant-access-specifiers` in the CI configuration. It removes redundant `public:` and `private:` access specifiers across the codebase and adds `// NOLINT` suppressions to Qt header files where `Q_SLOTS` macros trigger the check.
result.problem: Redundant access specifiers clutter class declarations and can be reintroduced without automated linter enforcement in CI.
evidence: Author PR description links to clang-tidy check documentation and explains suppressing Qt occurrences: 'Add `// NOLINT` to the Qt code, given that it will soon be replaced.'
result.scope_notes: Most changes are mechanical one-line additions of `// NOLINT` comments next to `Q_SLOTS` declarations in Qt header files.
result.card: Enables the clang-tidy check readability-redundant-access-specifiers in CI to prevent redundant access specifiers across the codebase. It removes duplicate specifiers in core and utility files, and adds NOLINT comments to Qt headers where Q_SLOTS triggers the warning. This is an internal developer tooling and linting change with no behavioral impact.

risk.why: The patch only removes duplicate C++ access specifiers and adds linter annotations without changing code logic.
